name: cwallmonitor
description: Registers cwm-mcp — the local broker for the C Wall Monitor ESP32 device. Provides 14 diagnostic and control tools (status/health/logs, device registry + provisioning, config + firmware OTA staging, revert and update checks) and four on-device skills (/cwallmonitor:configure for first-time pairing, /cwallmonitor:settings to remotely change any runtime setting the on-device Settings panel exposes, /cwallmonitor:theme as a shortcut for Day/Night/Auto theme switching, /cwallmonitor:firmware to push an OTA build). Runs alongside Claude Code with leader-elected coexistence so multiple sessions and an existing systemd daemon don't fight over the broker port. Self-contained: bundles the MCP server under server/ and resolves its runtime (Node, Python or Go) on first launch into a per-user cache — no separate go install / pipx / npm step.
